cancer.read: Two water signs who speak the same emotional language, and it shows from the very first conversation. Cancer offers the safety and steadiness Pisces craves, while Pisces brings imagination and softness that makes Cancer feel truly seen. When both are honest about what they need, this bond feels like coming home.
cancer.why: You both lead with feeling, so trust builds fast and deep.

gemini.read: This pairing can feel like two different weather systems sharing one sky. Gemini moves fast, talks fast, and loves variety, while Pisces moves slowly, feels deeply, and needs quiet to recharge. The spark is real — Gemini keeps Pisces curious and Pisces softens Gemini — but it only works when Gemini slows down to listen and Pisces says plainly what they need instead of hoping it will be guessed.
gemini.why: Curiosity meets depth, but only if both slow down for each other.

sagittarius.read: Sagittarius is fire and freedom, Pisces is water and feeling, and that mix can either steam or fizzle. Sagittarius loves big plans and blunt honesty, while Pisces loves gentle closeness and can bruise easily. The adventure is real and the laughter is easy, but it holds together only when Sagittarius softens the edges and Pisces speaks up instead of swimming away.
sagittarius.why: Adventure meets tenderness, but the pace and the tone have to be negotiated.

scorpio.read: Scorpio and Pisces understand each other in a way few other pairings do. Scorpio brings intensity and loyalty, Pisces brings compassion and imagination, and together they build a bond that feels almost private — a world of two. The depth is the gift and the risk: both feel everything, so honesty and space matter as much as closeness.
scorpio.why: Two deep waters that recognize each other instantly.

taurus.read: Taurus gives Pisces something rare: solid ground that never feels like a cage. Taurus is steady, patient, and devoted, and Pisces brings the color, warmth, and dreaming that keeps Taurus's world from feeling too small. It is a gentle, unhurried love that grows stronger the longer it goes.
taurus.why: Steadiness anchors the dreamer, and the dreamer keeps the anchor from feeling dull.

moonMeanings.first-quarter: A time for choosing. The first-quarter moon is often read as a moment to commit to one direction — to stop circling the wish and take the first small, real step toward it.
moonMeanings.full: A time for seeing clearly. The full moon is often read as a moment when feelings surface and things come to a head — a good time to notice what has been growing and name it out loud.
moonMeanings.last-quarter: A time for letting go. The last-quarter moon is often read as a moment to release what is no longer working, forgive what needs forgiving, and clear space for what comes next.
moonMeanings.new: A time for beginnings. The new moon is often read as a blank page — a moment to set an intention, plant a wish, and let yourself imagine what the next cycle could hold.
moonMeanings.waning-crescent: A time for rest and quiet. The waning crescent is often read as the softest part of the cycle — a moment to surrender, to sleep on it, and to trust that not everything needs solving today.
moonMeanings.waning-gibbous: A time for gratitude and reflection. The waning gibbous is often read as a moment to look back on what the full moon revealed and to thank what went right before moving on.
moonMeanings.waxing-crescent: A time for first steps. The waxing crescent is often read as the tender beginning of a plan — when a wish starts to take shape and the smallest action counts.
moonMeanings.waxing-gibbous: A time for refining. The waxing gibbous is often read as the stretch before the peak — a moment to adjust, to polish, and to trust that the work is nearly ready.

myth: The story goes that the goddess Aphrodite and her son Eros were walking by the river Euphrates when the monster Typhon appeared. To escape, they leapt into the water and were changed into two fish, tied together by a silver cord so they would never lose each other in the dark current. The two fish — one swimming upstream, one downstream — became Pisces: a sign that holds two directions at once, always pulled between the dream and the world, and always bound to what it loves.
name: Pisces
needs: Quiet time alone to recharge and dream
To be believed when they say how they feel
A creative outlet — music, art, writing, or making
Someone who protects their softness instead of using it
Room to feel big feelings without being called dramatic

profile.read: Born on March 1, you sit near the very start of Pisces, where the sign's dreaminess runs at full strength. You feel things before you think them, and your imagination is not an escape — it is how you understand the world. Your challenge is the same as your gift: you give your whole heart to people and ideas, so the work is learning which ones deserve it. When you protect your softness instead of hiding it, it becomes your sharpest strength.

shadows.text: When feelings get heavy, disappearing into sleep, screens, or daydreams can feel easier than facing them.
shadows.title: Escapist

shadows.text: A vivid imagination can turn a small worry into a whole story before the facts have had a chance to speak.
shadows.title: Overly idealistic

shadows.text: Saying yes to everyone leaves nothing left for yourself — and then the resentment quietly builds.
shadows.title: Boundaryless

shadows.text: Absorbing other people's moods can leave Pisces carrying feelings that were never theirs to begin with.
shadows.title: Absorbs others' pain

strengths.title: Imaginative

strengths.text: Tuned into the undercurrents most people walk straight past.
strengths.title: Intuitive

strengths.text: Offers warmth and understanding without being asked.
strengths.title: Gentle

strengths.text: Forgives easily and believes people can change.
